observed: 2026-11-07, dev box, no AWS. The binary run directly (not through Harbor, so Harbor's alias override was never involved) in an isolated network namespace (unshare -rn) against a scripted loopback mock of /v1/messages. Env: ANTHROPIC_MODEL = M; ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL = their own 5.5 ids, ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL = the Haiku id, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL = the Fable id; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL unset; the non-essential-traffic switches; flags as Harbor's claude-code agent: --verbose --output-format=stream-json --effort high --disallowedTools WebSearch,WebFetch --permission-mode=bypassPermissions --print. The mock scripted, in one session: Bash, then Agent(subagent_type Explore), Agent(general-purpose), Agent(Plan), Bash with a near-window usage report (995,000 input tokens) to force auto-compaction, a text answer to the summarization request, then end_turn. Run once for each M.

main.how: requests without x-claude-code-agent-id whose system opening is the main-loop prompt (Sonnet: 5 before and 1 after the compaction)

task.how: Agent tool_use with subagent_type general-purpose; its requests carry x-claude-code-agent-id

plan.how: Agent tool_use with subagent_type Plan; x-claude-code-agent-id

explore.how: Agent tool_use with subagent_type Explore; x-claude-code-agent-id. Not Haiku in 2.1.318: the Explore definition inherits the main model

compaction.how: auto-compaction after the near-window usage report: same system and tools as the main loop, the summarization instruction in the last user message; the stream-json log shows compact_boundary. Opus and Haiku sessions ended at the blocking limit before a summarization request reached the mock (Claude Code's own stop on the injected usage); the request type is the main lineage's, so M is expected there too

background.how: no request without tools (titles, summaries, command-prefix checks) occurred in --print mode with bypassPermissions in any session

conclusion: In --print mode, 2.1.318 requests the main model M for every observed request type; Claude Code's native defaults put no call on Haiku unless M is Haiku. 'Helper' (a Haiku-named call in A, B or C) is expected to be empty; any such call is reported, never remapped.

classifier.note: Structural request type (hproxy call_type), from text-free features: whether x-claude-code-agent-id is present, sha256[:12] of the first 60 characters of the last system block (system_sig), sha256[:12] of the sorted tool names (tools_sig), whether tools are present, and Claude Code's own summarization marker in the last user message (compaction). Anything else is unknown.
